bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears received encouraging health updates ahead of their Week 1 opener, with left tackle Braxton Jones confirmed to start Sunday and left tackle Ozzy Trapilo reportedly progressing well, while wide receiver Rome Odunze also returned to practice after a calf injury scare and was cleared on the team's first official injury report of the season. Bears coach Ben Johnson on Tuesday revealed that veteran Braxton Jones will start Sunday's season opener against the Panthers at left tackle.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are gearing up for their Week 1 showdown against the New Orleans Saints at Ford Field, with quarterback the Saints face a difficult Week 1 test against Jared Goff and the Lions' high-powered offense as New Orleans prepares for a hostile trip to Ford Field. Meanwhile, Detroit enters the opener with a full roster, as the Detroit Lions are entering Week 1 of the 2026 season with everyone on the 52-man roster practicing.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: Green Bay's biggest storyline heading into Sunday's Week 1 opener at Minnesota is the health of left tackle Jordan Morgan, who is dealing with a knee injury, though head coach Matt LaFleur believes his status will be fine after he participated in practice in a limited capacity, even as the knee issue was significant enough to land him on the injury report. Beyond the injury news, quarterback Jordan Love is rightfully viewed by most NFL front office evaluators and coaches as an ascending star at the position, with weapons like Matthew Golden, Christian Watson, and Tucker Kraft poised to make the passing game explosive as Green Bay opens its season against the Vikings.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings enter Sunday's Week 1 matchup against the Green Bay Packers at U.S. Bank Stadium in strong health, with Thursday's injury report showing the Minnesota Vikings continue to be relatively healthy as Week 1 approaches , notably with J.J.
